title.narrative: Rajasthan Urban Sector Development Investment Program - Tranche 3
Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved urban services in the 15 ULBs.

Population with piped sewerage increased from current negligible levels in 15% in Chittorgarh. Progress/Status: Sewerage infrastructure in Chittorgarh completed. Exact percentage of population benefitted to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: State and Local government statistics and reports, and IPMU progress reports. IPMU progress reports, and ADB mission reports. Actual value:

IPMU progress reports, and ADB mission reports. Actual value:

Drinking water quality in (Baran and Chittorgarh) meets water quality standards of India, and average duration of supply increased from 1 hour per day to at least 8 hours per day. Progress/Status: Drinking water quality in Baran and Chittorgarh meets government standards. Duration of supply has increased. However, exact figures to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: State and Local government statistics and reports, and IPMU progress reports. IPMU progress reports, and ADB mission reports. Actual value:

Non-revenue water reduced from approximately 40% to 20% in Baran and Chittorgarh. Progress/Status: NRW being progressively reduced. Exact figures to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: State and Local government statistics and reports, and IPMU progress reports. IPMU progress reports, and ADB mission reports. Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Fire Fighting strengthened in at least 5 ULBs. Indicator: Response time of fire tenders to reach fire-affected places reduced to acceptable levels in the concerned ULBs. Progress/Status: Reduction in response time of fire tenders to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: IPMU project completion reports, and ADB review mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Heritage sites in 7 ULBs conserved. Indicator: Heritage sites in 7 ULBs conserved. Progress/Status: Heritage sites conserved in 6 ULBs. Data Source: IPMU project completion reports, and ADB review mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Implementing Agencies and IAs effectively manage project financed assets. Indicator: At least 100 ULB Staff, IA Staff trained in social-inclusive and gender responsive O&M services, financial management. Progress/Status: Total of 227 staff of IA and ULBs have been trained on construction, management, O&M services, safeguards policies and implementation, CDM and water supply management. Data Source: IPMU project completion reports, and ADB review mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Improved and increased metered water supply service area in Baran and Chittorgarh. Indicator: Consumer water meters numbering 12,600 in Baran and 10,500 in Chittorgarh installed/replaced (25% of which are slum/low income or woment headed households). Progress/Status: 10,539 consumer water meters installed/ replaced in Baran of which 39% (4,113 nos) are in slum/ low income or women-headed households, while 28% (2,953 nos) of the 10,409 water meters installed in Chittorgarh are in such households. Data Source: IPMU quarterly reports Budgets and annual work plans, ADB Mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Improved and increased metered water supply service area in Baran and Chittorgarh. Indicator: Population having individual piped water connections increased to 90% in service area and to 95% in slums in slum/low income areas in Baran and Chittorgarh. Progress/Status: Number of beneficiaries to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: IPMU quarterly reports Budgets and annual work plans, ADB Mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Increased sewerage treatment coverage in the 5 ULBs. Indicator: Service area coverage with piped sewerage system increased from current negligible level to 47% in Churu; 70% in Karauli; 21% in Bharatpur; 15% in Chittorgarh; and 36% in Jaisalmer. Progress/Status: Sewer line works completed in 5 ULBs. Increase in service area coverage to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: IPMU Quarterly progress reports, budgets and annual work plans, ADB Mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Increased sewerage treatment coverage in the 5 ULBs. Indicator: Sewerage treatment capacity increased from current negligible level to 7 MLD in Churu; 5 MLD in Karauli; 8 MLD in Bharatpur; 5 MLD in Chittorgarh; and 10 MLD in Jaisalmer; and Reuse and/or recycle of effluent of sewerage treatment plant established on pilot. Progress/Status: Works completed and sewerage treatment capacity increased to 7 MLD in Churu; 5 MLD in Karauli; 8 MLD in Bharatpur; 5 MLD in Chittorgarh; and 10 MLD in Jaisalmer. Reuse/ recycling of treated wastewater is being considered. Data Source: IPMU Quarterly progress reports, budgets and annual work plans, ADB Mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Increased solid waste collection and disposal in 10 ULBs. Indicator: Solid waste collected and transported to landfill sites as percentage of generation increased to at least 80% in all ULBs. Progress/Status: Solid waste collection and transportation equipment procured and supplied to 15 program ULBs has increased collection and transportation. However, extent of increase in collection to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: IPMU project completion reports, and ADB review mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Traffic flow improved as a result of construction of two minor bridges in Sawai Madhopur and one road work in Dholpur. Indicator: Reduction in travel time from an average of 1.5 hours to 30 minutes to get through one end of the city to the other end in the cornered two cities. Progress/Status: Works completed and has reduced travel time, extent of which will be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: IPMU project completion reports, and ADB review mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Reduced flooding through improved urban drainage in Sawai Madhopur. Indicator: Reduction in the incidence of street flooding from an average of 60 days per year to about 15 days per year. Progress/Status: Works completed. Reduction in incidence of flooding to be reported in Facility Completion Stage. Data Source: IPMU quarterly progress reports, budgets and annual work plans, ADB mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Improved and increased metered water supply service area in Baran and Chittorgarh. Indicator: Service coverage with piped water supply increased from 70% or 70,000 beneficiaries to 90% or 105,000 in Baran, and 64% or 83,000 to 90% or 148,000 beneficiaries in Chittorgarh. Progress/Status: Number of beneficiaries to be reported in Facility Completion Report. Data Source: IPMU quarterly reports Budgets and annual work plans, ADB Mission reports. Actual value:

Output: Implementing Agencies and IAs effectively manage project financed assets. Indicator: Community awareness campaigns on health, housing, sanitation, gender issues conducted in the 15 ULBs. Progress/Status: Around 17,500 community awareness campaigns on health, housing, sanitation, and gender issues conducted in 15 ULBs. Data Source: IPMU project completion reports, and ADB review mission reports. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y
